learning_objective: 🎯 Discover the super fun games our grandparents used to play and learn amazing teamwork, clever strategies, and lightning-fast agility!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Games like Kho-Kho teach you to sprint fast and dodge your opponents quickly! You have to twist, turn, and stay super alert to win.
In games like Kabaddi, you cannot win alone. You must talk to your friends, make smart plans, and work together like a superhero squad!
The best part about traditional Indian games is that you do not need expensive gear. Just a playground, your friends, and tons of energy!

fun_activity.title: 🏃‍♂️ The Ultimate Tag Team Dash
fun_activity.instructions: Gather your friends in the park and play a game of chain tag! Once you tag someone, you must hold hands and catch the others together like a giant moving net.

quick_recap: ⭐ Traditional games build strong leg muscles and help you make quick decisions.
⭐ Always communicate loudly and clearly with your team to trap your opponents.
⭐ Play fair, respect the rules, and always shake hands after a great match!
